Received the exact five-file `ad08ad8ceb3aec4247a760feee848f259eac437e` proposal against `f2c886bca9bb7f0a03de753efdb9cc872a3e3e04`. This remains distinct open work under #22; it is not being closed as a duplicate or merged over the original PR23 carrier contract.

| Candidate capability | Existing shared owner / actual receiving | Disposition |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Selected source/archive/installed byte and kind comparison; literal names and executable intent | The same `./artifact-release` and existing comparison CLI now have a coherent local source union preserving PR23, qualified through the original61-file suite:448/448. The actual Code0.14.22 archive86 and genuine97 installation86/26 registered bins passed the source-program comparison, with source-bin promotion and installed-bin loss controls refusing. This is not a released checker claim. | Preserve the shared owner; carry Code/Git/GHS actual receiver migration through release. |
| Independent source selection / typed Git mode evidence | Original Git modes/blob IDs stay at their native reader, separate from numeric permissions. Initial archive-derived names establish correspondence only. A separate original `carrierSourceIncludes` application to all156 immutable merged-source paths selects86 independently, exactly matching the actual Code86 set. | Bind that selection witness and repeat the actual-adapter obligation for Git/GHS. A pure supplied selection address cannot authenticate itself. |
| Fatal UTF8, wrong/mixed-stage and unknown-field controls | These are useful additional controls. The current CLI already bounds intake during growth at8MiB and supports exclusive output; its decoder currently permits UTF8 replacement. | Propose narrow fatal-decoding and strict partial-stage/mixed-unit controls before publication, preserving the original bound/output and caller-data ownership. No completed fix claimed yet. |
| Native644→755-only exception | Actual PNPM receiving includes59 non-bin0600→0644 and6 bin0600→0755 transitions with equal bytes. The actual NPM bin-links primitive applies0777&~umask, yielding0700 under the private0077 context. The current shared source binds those finite native laws to operation/provider/lock/registered-target receipts. | Preserve this stricter alternative proposal, but do not replace witnessed competent native laws with a rule that refuses those real cohorts. Native Git/GHS installation remains unreceived until its own tiny ordinary manager operation; source contexts are not that proof. |
| Received expected publisher bytes versus fixed original publisher serialization | Current original publisher receiving binds the actual merge head and its exact sole gitHead/json-2-newline projection, with wrong stamp/extra-field/serialization counterexamples. | Keep differently serialized publisher support as distinct work requiring a real selected publisher and received bytes. Do not add an arbitrary publisher-byte waiver. |
| Full version2 release replaces legacy complete input | This is a separate compatibility-impacting acceptance contract, not the optional partial-stage addition. The original full interface and two original controls remain preserved; its inventory evidence must not be called byte/native completeness. | Keep the full-release refinement, known-caller migration and release-selector judgment open here; do not silently remove the legacy capability or claim its path inventories discharge #22. |
| Structured archive-reader adapter / maintained parser dependency | Your proposal correctly records that the pure model is not an archive reader or native authority. No declared tar dependency/lock/adapter qualification is present in this cut. | Keep proper-owner native reader/producer adapter and normal supplier-policy qualification obligations open; no private npm-internal parser, fabricated lock or installed-consumer claim. |

The reported439 branch cases and earlier environment-limited attempt remain original evidence, not a fresh closure claim from this intake. All five Git blobs and the detailed source/test/consumer disposition are retained in the original release Work. SHA256-repository inputs, the complete v2 release interface and alternate publisher representation remain explicit distinct obligations. No source push, supersession, branch retirement, package overwrite or issue closure follows from this comment.

The compatible shared-owner forward is now actually released as Code0.14.23 from normal PR25 merge bc494ee673f59fcdccc939a6102ae089fac1658b. It preserves landed carrier PR23, the original no-stage inventory interface, and this PR's distinct obligations; it does not replace the full interface with the proposed v2 contract.

The useful fatal UTF8, strict partial-stage/wrong-unit and latest957c9f literal digest-type counterexamples were carried into the shared model/CLI. Qualification keeps source identities separate: prior560 coherent whole61 files451/451; final554 literal-identity affected17/17 and genuinely packed17/17. Actual named registry publication and all87 source/archive bytes+executable intents were independently received, including the sole actual merge stamp.

The released registered comparison CLI has now received actual native NPM file-directory installations of Code0.14.23/Git0.1.9/GHS0.2.4:242 payload members and47 registered bins across their unchanged own13/3/7 provider contexts, with genuine3-entry locks and frozen ci. All six source/archive and archive/installed positives and the lost-bin refusal passed. These are real bounded native operations, not fresh97/815/whole-GHS graph claims. Independent original prepublication source-pack selections bind the Git99/GHS56 member sets; the pure model does not authenticate its own supplied facts.

Remaining work here stays open: compatibility-impacting full-v2 release/caller migration and proper release selection; SHA256 Git repository inputs; a genuinely selected alternate publisher serialization; reusable maintained native archive adapters and their supplier/lock/native-caller receiving. Task adapters used for the actual receives are not being presented as that shipped capability. The original440 author-reported aggregate remains its own evidence. This comment does not close or supersede this PR, authorize arbitrary publisher bytes, waive native manager laws, or claim installed machine/publisher uptake.

Current PR head957c9f remains open/draft. Its full replacement now conflicts with the living shared model, so a successor integration must reconcile the distinct requirements against that model and its actual receipts, rather than selecting either branch wholesale. PR15 authority and issue17's real large consumer remain separate.
